heroText: Bodø works best as a base in Norway when you anchor days around Saltstraumen, Norwegian Aviation Museum and Bodo harbour. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Bodø Airport (BOO) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

stayOverview: Start with City centre for the easiest first Bodø stay, then compare Old Town and Waterfront when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
